title: Update server startup output to print clickable dashboard URL

plan: Update server.py __main__ block to print explicit http://localhost:9000 and http://127.0.0.1:9000 links on server startup so users in modern terminals/IDEs can click directly into the dashboard.
resolution_notes: Implemented get_startup_urls and get_startup_banner in server.py to print formatted clickable URLs (http://localhost:9000 and http://127.0.0.1:9000) along with API sync endpoints upon startup. Verified with tests/test_server.py.

title: Clean up unhandled KeyboardInterrupt traceback when stopping server via Ctrl+C
description: When stopping server.py using CTRL-C, Python dumps an unhandled KeyboardInterrupt stack traceback instead of exiting cleanly with a graceful shutdown message.
cause: server.py executes httpd.serve_forever() without catching KeyboardInterrupt or SystemExit, causing standard Python stack trace output upon Ctrl+C.
plan: Wrap httpd.serve_forever() in try...except (KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit) in server.py, perform clean socket shutdown, and log a friendly exit message.
resolution_notes: Wrapped socketserver loop in try...except (KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit) with clean console exit banner.

title: Week 27 report pack in Google Drive folder is not detected/activated upon 'Sync Workspace'
description: Week 27 pack was added to the drive folder. The file is visible in Drive scan, but clicking 'Sync Workspace' leaves the dashboard showing Week 26 instead of updating the live dashboard view to Week 27.
cause:
1. DRIVE_REPORTS in index.html is statically seeded through Week 26.
2. syncGoogleSheet() fetches /api/sync-sheet (which lacked snapshots) and calls checkDriveSyncStatus() but never updates activeTimeMachineWeek or executes activateTimeMachine(getLatestWeekKey()).
3. Header report buttons (#driveReportLink), live status pill (#liveStatusBadge), and Time Machine return banner contained hardcoded Week 26 text instead of dynamically updating to the latest ingested snapshot.
plan:
1. In server.py, include snapshots payload in /api/sync-sheet response.
2. In index.html, update DRIVE_REPORTS to include Week 27 (1HBfI9itx3BER4IRnH9eavBgAsrDGHnmu).
3. In syncGoogleSheet() and initApp(), dynamically sync TIME_MACHINE_SNAPSHOTS from server response and automatically invoke activateTimeMachine(getLatestWeekKey()) to switch the entire dashboard to Week 27.
4. Dynamically update #driveReportLink href/text to always point to the latest week's Drive pack.
5. Write automated reproduction test verifying that syncWorkspace/syncGoogleSheet updates active week to Week 27.
resolution_notes:
1. Updated /api/sync-sheet in server.py to bundle snapshots dictionary.
2. Updated DRIVE_REPORTS in index.html to include Week 27 pack.
3. Updated syncGoogleSheet() and initApp() in index.html to update TIME_MACHINE_SNAPSHOTS and automatically invoke activateTimeMachine(getLatestWeekKey()).
4. Made header link, return to present button, and live status badge dynamic across snapshots.
5. Added and verified 9 unit tests across server startup, sync APIs, and Week 27 ingestion.

title: 'undefined' displayed instead of week labels in Time Machine modal list
description: In the F-DSE Governance Time Machine modal list, historical weekly snapshot items display 'undefined (31 Jul 2026)', 'undefined (24 Jul 2026)', 'undefined (17 Jul 2026)', 'undefined (10 Jul 2026)', and 'undefined (03 Jul 2026)' instead of proper week names (e.g. 'Week 26', 'Week 25').
cause: In weekly_snapshots.json (and TIME_MACHINE_SNAPSHOTS), historical snapshots w26 through w22 define 'weekLabel' and 'weekNumber' rather than 'week'. In index.html, renderTimeMachineModalList() accesses '${snap.week}', which evaluates to undefined when 'week' is undefined on older snapshots.
plan:
1. In index.html, update renderTimeMachineModalList() (and related snapshot accessors) to robustly resolve week names via `snap.week || snap.weekLabel || ('Week ' + (snap.weekNumber || ''))`.
2. In src/data/weekly_snapshots.json, normalize all snapshot entries to include both 'week' and 'weekLabel'.
3. Add an automated test in tests/test_server.py asserting no undefined labels appear in snapshot modal rendering.
resolution_notes:
1. Updated renderTimeMachineModalList() and activateTimeMachine() in index.html to resolve week names with fallback: `snap.week || snap.weekLabel || ('Week ' + (snap.weekNumber || ''))`.
2. Normalized all snapshot records in weekly_snapshots.json to include both 'week' and 'weekLabel'.
3. Added automated unit tests in tests/test_server.py verifying all snapshots define valid week names and fallback logic works properly.

title: Bad text wrapping in Executive Cockpit KPI status pill (ATO-C GATE)
description: In the Executive Cockpit top banner, the ATO-C GATE KPI badge has bad text wrapping where 'ATO-C GATE:' wraps across 3 awkward vertical lines ('ATO-', 'C', 'GATE:') causing excessive vertical height and misaligned pills.
cause: In updateAtoGateKpi(statusText), cardKpiAto.className dynamically overwrote the element's class list with classes that dropped 'whitespace-nowrap' and 'shrink-0' and increased padding/font size (px-3 py-1.5 text-xs vs px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px]), causing the label 'ATO-C Gate:' to wrap across 3 lines in standard viewports.
plan: Add 'whitespace-nowrap shrink-0' to all 4 KPI pill wrappers and inner label spans in #execKpisGrid, and harmonize updateAtoGateKpi() to retain 'px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap shrink-0'.
resolution_notes:
1. Added whitespace-nowrap and shrink-0 to all 4 KPI pill wrappers and child spans in #execKpisGrid.
2. Harmonized updateAtoGateKpi() to maintain consistent px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap shrink-0.
3. Verified with automated unit test test_kpi_pill_wrapping_classes.

title: Add 'Create a Slide' button near 'Copy Synthesis' to generate presentation slides from executive summary panels
description: Add a 'Create a slide' button near 'Copy Synthesis' to make presentation slides from the executive summary. Perhaps several slides, 1 for each panel on that page.
cause: Executive Briefing card currently provides 'Copy Briefing Text' and 'Generate Audio Briefing' but lacks an automated presentation slide export for individual panels or full executive decks.
plan: Add a '📊 Create Slide Deck' button in the executive briefing toolbar near 'Copy Synthesis'. Build an interactive slide generator modal and PPTX/HTML export supporting 4 structured slide layouts (Slide 1: Executive Cockpit & KPIs, Slide 2: Gemini Decision Briefing, Slide 3: Top 3 Actions & Outliers, Slide 4: Gap Close Glidepaths).

title: Clicking on Risk Volume or Risk Mitigation (Burndown) graphs in Performance Trends tab does not drill down
description: On the Performance Trends tab (Tab 4), clicking on data points or bars in the Risk Volume (Backlog Timeline) and Risk Mitigation (Burndown Timeline) graphs does not trigger drill-down or time travel navigation.
cause: Chart.js instances for chartBacklogTimeline and chartBurndownTimeline lacked 'interaction: { mode: "index", intersect: false }' and 'events: ["click", "mousemove"]', requiring pixel-perfect clicks on thin lines or points. Additionally, clicking points only triggered a toast rather than opening a rich interactive weekly volume drill-down modal.
plan:
1. Configure 'interaction: { mode: "index", intersect: false }' on both Chart.js instances so clicking anywhere in the column slice fires reliably.
2. Implement openTimelineDrilldownModal(weekKey, metrics) presenting the full weekly breakdown of active risks, opened/closed counts, and score averages with a 1-click 'Travel to Week' action.
resolution_notes:
1. Added interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false } to chartBacklogTimeline and chartBurndownTimeline so clicking anywhere in a week column triggers the click handler.
2. Built #timelineDrilldownModal and openTimelineDrilldownModal(index, metrics) displaying comprehensive week performance metrics with 1-click 'Travel to Week' and 'Open Risk Explorer' actions.
3. Verified with automated unit test test_timeline_drilldown_modal_and_interaction.

plan: Unify risk card templates across both registers so all cards support BOTH in-line accordion expansion ('▾ View Root Cause & Mitigation') and full modal inspection ('Inspect Full Detail ↗'), with consistent Blueprint badges and control deltas.

title: Top 5 Critical Risks and Top 5 Issues cards in Executive Summary lack explicit drill-down actions
description: In the Executive Summary view, the Top 5 Critical Risks and Top 5 Escalated Issues cards need explicit, prominent drill-down capabilities (such as 'Inspect ↗' modal trigger and 1-click jump to the filtered Risk Explorer / Issue Register with Driver Tree ref and Blueprint Annex traceability).
cause: Top 5 risks and issues lists in Executive Summary lack explicit visual action buttons and deep filter jump handlers.
plan: Add explicit 'Inspect ↗' modal trigger buttons and 1-click filter jump links to Top 5 critical risks and escalated issues.

title: Executive Summary Audio Podcast player does not play audio
description: Clicking the Play button on the NotebookLM Neural Podcast briefing audio bar does not playback audio because the referenced audio file path (assets/podcast_w27.mp3 or assets/podcast_w26.mp3) is either missing, unserved, or lacking a browser-native Web Audio/Speech synthesis fallback.
cause: assets/podcast_w27.mp3 does not exist on disk, causing audio.play() to fail without playback or speech fallback.
plan: Generate Week 27 audio asset assets/podcast_w27.mp3 and wire an interactive Web Speech API dual-voice speech synthesizer fallback.

title: Inspect Full Details button on Team Google Risk cards does not open the detail modal
description: In the Team Google Risks tab, clicking the 'Inspect Full Detail ↗' button on any Team Google risk card fails to open the inspection modal due to ID lookup mismatch or unhandled event parameter in openItemDetailModal().
cause: openItemDetailModal ID lookup uses strict equality on r.id/r.displayId which fails when matching integer/string ID types across LIVE_TEAM_GOOGLE_RISKS.
plan: Make openItemDetailModal ID comparison type-agnostic (String(r.id) === String(itemId)) across both LIVE_RISKS and LIVE_TEAM_GOOGLE_RISKS, ensuring modal opens reliably with full Team Google metadata and Blueprint Annex.

title: Risk cards in Joint Program and Team Google lack visible clickable links/badges into Blueprint Knowledge
description: On the Joint Program Risks and Team Google Risks tabs, individual risk cards in the Live Risk Explorer do not feature visible, clickable 'Blueprint: Annex X' badges or 'View Blueprint ↗' links navigating directly to the matching Solution Bundle in Blueprint Knowledge and opening the Project Monaro Contract Notebook.
cause: renderRiskExplorer and renderTeamGoogleRiskExplorer templates do not resolve BUNDLE_ANNEX_MAPPING or render clickable Blueprint Annex badges on card headers.
plan: Resolve mapped Annex for every risk via BUNDLE_ANNEX_MAPPING and render a visible, clickable '📘 Blueprint: Annex X' badge and 'View Blueprint ↗' link jumping to Blueprint Knowledge with NotebookLM deep links.
